overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted professional presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, with a total audience of 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on academic research, computational social science, and tools for analyzing coordinated inauthentic behavior. Across all platforms, he enjoys high-quality engagement, particularly when sharing career opportunities, research milestones, and software updates like CooRnet v2.0.

contentThemes.description: Updates on software releases (CooRnet v2.0) and academic papers detailing coordinated link-sharing detection.
Callouts for open positions, including postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Announcements of newly awarded research grants and publications focused on information operations.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn to leverage the large follower base (1,850) for recruiting and professional networking.
Include direct hyperlinks to papers, tools, and job descriptions to boost click-through rates and practical utility.
Utilize targeted hashtags on Bluesky and Mastodon (e.g., #AcademicSky, #CSS) to extend organic reach beyond existing followers.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky represents the most active and receptive audience with an average engagement rate of over 6%. It is highly effective for immediate peer feedback, academic discussions, and attracting PhD prospects.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides steady engagement from a niche academic community, particularly receptive to technical software updates like CooRnet, but has the lowest overall posting volume.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn has the largest audience and drives the highest absolute engagement. It performs exceptionally well for institutional announcements, such as research grants and hiring postdoctoral candidates.
